headline: GOLD SLIPS TO $4,522 as Iran War Uncertainty and Rising Bond Yields Weigh on Markets
snippet: Gold's spot price fell to $4,522/oz on May 26 as geopolitical uncertainty over the US-Iran conflict kept inflation fears elevated, despite gold still trading 36% higher year-over-year. The precious metal has pulled back nearly 15% since the conflict began, with tight monetary policy expectations offsetting safe-haven demand.

headline: SILVER SURGES 2.6% to $77.50 — Six Straight Years of Structural Deficit as Solar, Investment Demand Roar
snippet: Silver jumped to $77.50/oz on May 26, up $1.98 on the day, as the Silver Institute forecasts a 67-million-ounce supply shortfall in 2026 — the sixth consecutive year demand outstrips mine output. China's record silver imports, driven by solar manufacturers and retail investors, are a primary driver of the sustained squeeze.

headline: GR SILVER SMASHES ITS OWN RECORD: 45.1m at 1,623 g/t Ag — Best Hole Ever at San Marcial
snippet: GR Silver Mining (TSXV: GRSL) announced its best-ever drill results from hole SMS26-04 at San Marcial on May 19, intercepting 45.1 metres at 1,623 g/t Ag, including an astounding 8.25 metres at 8,579 g/t Ag. The company's 20,000-metre step-out program has three rigs turning, targeting an updated resource estimate and PEA in H2 2026.

headline: TROILUS EXPANDS West Rim Discovery 200m from Reserve Pit: 2.92 g/t AuEQ Over 19m Outside Resource
snippet: Troilus Mining (TSX: TLG) reported the first results from its 2026 West Rim drilling campaign on May 19, with highlight hole WR-26-016 cutting 19 metres at 2.69 g/t Au — all outside the current mineral resource and within 200 metres of the North Reserve Pit. Analysts note the high-grade near-pit results underscore M&A optionality for the Quebec copper-gold project.

headline: MINRES REBOOTS BALD HILL: ASX Lithium Giant Restarts 18-Month Suspended Mine as Prices Hit 3-Year High
snippet: Mineral Resources announced on May 19 it will restart the Bald Hill spodumene mine in Western Australia — idled since November 2024 — after lithium carbonate prices in China surged past CNY 200,000/tonne, the highest in nearly three years. First shipment is targeted for Q1 FY2027, with restart costs of approximately A$20 million and approximately 370 jobs created.

headline: LITHIUM CARBONATE HITS NEAR 3-YEAR HIGH as Energy Storage Demand Jumps 55% — Producers Rush to Restart
snippet: Lithium carbonate prices in China surged to a near 3-year high above CNY 200,000/tonne in mid-May 2026, driven by a projected 55% jump in energy storage demand for the year following 71% growth in 2025. The price spike is incentivizing idled producers to restart operations, with energy storage set to account for 31% of total lithium consumption in 2026.

headline: US SLAPS 132.83% Anti-Dumping Duty on Russian Palladium — 241% Combined Rate Could Reshape Supply Chain
snippet: The US Department of Commerce finalized a 132.83% anti-dumping duty plus a 109.1% countervailing duty on Russian unwrought palladium on May 21, bringing combined potential tariffs to 241.93% at a time when Nornickel faces a projected 20-year production low. The action was driven by a petition from Sibanye-Stillwater and the United Steelworkers union to protect North American producers.

headline: JUGGERNAUT DRILLS THE GOLDEN TRIANGLE: 10,000m Inaugural Program Launches at New District-Scale Big One Discovery
snippet: Juggernaut Exploration (TSXV: JUGR) mobilized on May 19 for the inaugural 10,000-metre drill program at its Big One property in BC's Golden Triangle, where surface samples have assayed up to 263.70 g/t AuEq across more than 400 mineralized veins up to 10 metres wide. Free milling gold confirmed in February makes this a high-priority first drill test of a potentially district-scale system.

headline: EQUINOX GOLD BUYS ORLA MINING in $18.5B All-Share Deal — Creates Canada's No. 2 Gold Producer at 1.1 Moz
snippet: Equinox Gold and Orla Mining announced a definitive all-share merger on May 13 to create a senior North American gold producer with a combined market cap of US$18.5 billion and projected 2026 production of 1.1 million ounces across six operating mines. The combined company has a clear path to 1.9 Moz annually, with Equinox CEO Darren Hall leading and deal close expected in Q3 2026.

headline: CHINA'S SILVER GRAB: 790+ Tonnes in Early 2026 — Solar and Retail Drive Sixth Consecutive Deficit Year
snippet: China imported over 790 tonnes of silver in the first two months of 2026, an eight-year high, with March surging to 836 tonnes against a 10-year seasonal average of only 306 — fueled by solar manufacturers and retail investors diversifying out of gold. The Silver Institute's 2026 deficit forecast of 67 million ounces marks the sixth straight year of structural undersupply.

headline: GOLD MINERS OUTPERFORM THE METAL — GDX +50% YTD While S&P 500 Falls 10% in 2026's Bifurcated Market
snippet: Gold miners are delivering the long-anticipated leverage play in 2026, with the Gold Miners Index up approximately 50% year-to-date through April while the S&P 500 declined 10%, and the leveraged GDMN vehicle posting 226% gains in 2025 followed by 58% in early 2026. Analysts argue that record gold margins near $2,800/oz and a long-overdue sector re-rating are the structural drivers — not just the gold price itself.

headline: COPPER DEFICIT DEEPENS: 600,000-Tonne Shortfall Forecast as Grasberg Delays Full Restart to 2028
snippet: Morgan Stanley forecasts a 600,000-tonne refined copper deficit in 2026, with Freeport-McMoRan's Grasberg mine delaying a full restart from 2027 to 2028 after a catastrophic 2025 mudslide that pruned output by 35%. Section 232 tariff risks compound the supply squeeze, with copper futures near $6.20/lb after briefly setting a record high of $6.65 in mid-May.
